name: @amykit/plugin-ui-stub
description: The stub renderers that draw exactly the frame: one in pixels, one in cells. What the conformance script is proven against before a real window exists.
author: Nicolas Melo

amy.about: You do not install this one: it is private and never published. It holds the stub renderers, one in pixels and one in cells, that draw exactly the frame and nothing else. The ui conformance script is proven against them before a real renderer exists.
